Press Releases

FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship: Possible time adjustments for the semi-finals
The FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship Canada 2002 Organizing Committee has announced a possible time adjustment for the semi-finals for TV purposes. 24 Aug 2002

Disciplinary Status of the quarter-finalists
The FIFA Disciplinary Committee has confirmed that all suspensions from the first round have been served. 23 Aug 2002

Referee assignments for quarter-final Brazil vs. Australia
FIFA Referees' Committee has assigned the following match officials for the first FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship quarter-finals to be played in Vancouver on 24 August 2002, at 19:00 (local time) : 22 Aug 2002

FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship - Road to quarter-finals
As a reminder, here are the regulations governing the qualification process for the quarter-finals of the FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship Canada 2002 : 21 Aug 2002

FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship - Japan replaces two players
Japan's Head Coach, Shibuno IKEDA, had no other option today than replace two of his players who were injured during last night's game versus Canada (0-4) in Edmonton. 21 Aug 2002

FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship - One change in the US squad
USA's Head Coach, Tracey LEONE has made today in Victoria one change in the list of players that have started the tournament. 20 Aug 2002

Two changes in the Nigerian squad
Nigeria's Head Coach, Ntiero EFFIOM NTIERO has made today in Edmonton two changes in the list of the players initially foreseen. 17 Aug 2002

CHANGE - FIFA Press Conference on 16 August in Edmonton
The press conference to follow the meeting of the FIFA Organizing Committee for the FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship will be rescheduled for Friday 16 August at 10.45 am. It is still at the Edmonton Westin Hotel. FIFA Executive Committee member and CONCACAF President Jack Warner will conduct this press conference. 14 Aug 2002

Bahrain Football Association considers bid for 2004 FIFA Futsal World Championship
The Bahrain Football Association declared its interest in hosting the 2004 FIFA Futsal World Championship. In a meeting today Friday, 9 August, at FIFA headquarters in Zurich, the Minister of Sports of the Kingdom of Bahrain, Sheik Fawaz al Khalifa, informed FIFA President Joseph S. Blatter on this plan and assured the government’s support. 09 Aug 2002

FIFA Press Conference on 15 August in Edmonton
The meeting of the FIFA Organizing Committee for the FIFA U-19 Women's World Championship will be followed by a press conference in the Edmonton Westin Hotel starting at 6 pm. FIFA Executive Committee member and CONCACAF President Jack Warner will conduct this press conference. 09 Aug 2002

The FIFA Emergency Committee has decided to suspend the Tajikistan National Football Federation
The FIFA Emergency Committee has decided to suspend the Tajikistan National Football Federation (TNFF) . This suspension will apply until the situation returns to normal, according to the plan of action that will be defined by a FIFA/AFC delegation to visit this national association soon. 08 Aug 2002
